The UIScale columns show why a canvas scale is not used.

needsCapture: Capture PulseSpike_04 at DEVICE resolution (record the OS display scale and the capture's pixel size against cameraViewportSize - that ratio is the device-pixel ratio no script can read). Zoom in: (1) plain column - are the four 1 px lines identical in thickness and brightness, and the four 2 px lines? (2) the half-offset lines - blurred into two rows, or snapped? (3) each UIScale column - which lines are thicker, thinner, grey or missing? (4) bottom KitRule row - six crisp bars of 1,2,3,3,3,4 px. (5) the pink fractional probe. Repeat with ARGS.halfOrigin = true and on 125% / 150% displays.
